crossRefs.note: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
crossRefs.keyword: it is gone. Heb. it is not

crossRefs.note: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
crossRefs.keyword: it is gone. Heb. it is not

crossRefs.note: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
Behold, this is the joy of his way: out of the earth, others will spring.
The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

translations.web: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
translations.bsb: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
translations.kjv: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know
translations.asv: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.
